protocol_source: policies/dexbotic-benchmark/evaluation/configs/libero/libero_{spatial,object,goal,10}.yaml; evaluation/evaluator/libero_evaluator.py default send_image fallback; evaluation/policies/libero_vla_agent.py discrete_gripper default True
skip_semantics: hidden-update bypass with original-index KV shells
action_generation_boundary: prepared VLM condition and state/noise projection through final output projection; excludes decode

timing_boundaries.action_generation_ms: GPU stage: prepared model/mask VLM features and initial noise through state/action projection, all sampling updates and final output projection; excludes VLM prefill, decode, audit reductions and persistence
timing_boundaries.server_total_ms: prepare wall plus sampling/decode, trace reductions and CPU tensor copies; stops before result hash/row assembly, prediction/noise NPZ compression/write and ledger persistence; shared cache includes original prepare wall for comparability
timing_boundaries.request_wall_ms: independent predict wall including prepare, sampling/decode/audit, NPZ compression/write and prediction ledger append; excludes RPC transport and caller logs

persistence: disabled in adapter; rollout controls optional artifact I/O
concurrency: single model request at a time; multiple rollout clients overlap environment work
